title: Audit, upgrade and prune SDK deps; remove deprecated API params
creator: Marina Perez
description: Objective: Reduce client install footprint, remove deprecated top-level request fields, and bump critical transport/serialization libraries across Python, JS, and Go SDKs. This ticket covers audit, upgrade plan, compatibility shims, CI validation, and a staged client release. Motivation: multiple customers and internal services use older transports (node-fetch, requests, net/http hooks) and deprecated API params still surface in some SDK helpers. Upgrading will unblock runtime optimizations in the runtime team and remove maintenance burden of several in-repo shims.
acceptance_criteria: All three language SDKs have a documented dependency matrix with target versions and rationales
Compatibility shim implemented for the top 3 breaking deps where necessary
Deprecated API params (max_tokens_hint, old_stream_flag) removed from public client signatures and documented migration paths
CI matrices run successful integration tests against runtime-rc and hosted-mock without regression
Release notes and migration guide published in Confluence and linked from SDK changelogs
risks: Possible transient breakage for customers pinning transitive deps; mitigation: provide shim and deprecation warnings for two releases
Increased bundle size in JS if we choose polyfills incorrectly; mitigation: prefer undici/native fetch where supported
Binary incompatibilities for Go if net/http behavior changes; mitigation: run soak tests against Dedicated clusters
notes_and_plan: 2026-02-16: Kickoff meeting with SDK owners (Python: @marina, JS: @alex, Go: @samir). Agreed audit scope and target windows.

2026-02-20: Dependency audit complete. Found 4 transitive libs with high/severity alerts (python: urllib3 <1.26.15, js: node-fetch deprecated, go: golang.org/x/crypto outdated). See Confluence audit: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/SDK+Dep+Audit+2026-02

2026-02-24: Strategy: Pin safe majors for patch/bugfixes; upgrade transports: node-fetch -> undici (node16+), requests -> httpx (opt-in), keep requests as fallback; Go: update x/crypto and vendor checksum where necessary.
2026-02-28: Implemented compatibility shim in JS that exposes a fetch-wrapper preserving fetch signature; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/1812
2026-03-03: Python PR for optional httpx adapter created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/945; left requests as fallback with deprecation warning logged for two releases
2026-03-06: Go changes under review; added extended HTTP integration tests against internal runtime-rc cluster (dedicated). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/307
2026-03-09: CI work: expand matrix runners to include node16/node20, python3.9/3.10/3.11, go1.20/1.21. Build flakes observed on node20; tracing to CJS/ESM interop in bundler step (investigating).
2026-03-11: Security signoff required due to transport changes; ticket submitted to SecOps for dependency review (SEC-1234).
Rolling plan: publish minor releases with deprecation warnings (clients-2026.04-rc1), collect telemetry for 2 weeks, then promote to stable.
work_items: Audit and propose target versions for all runtime-impacting deps
Remove deprecated params from public helpers; add migration guide
Update CI matrices and add cross-language integration job
Coordinate changelog and release notes; prepare canary rollout
